```yaml
name: Deploy Lexical Search Worker

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --workspace=kentcdodds.com

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          npm run test --workspace lexical-search-worker
          npm run typecheck --workspace lexical-search-worker
          npm run lint --workspace lexical-search-worker
          npm exec --workspace kentcdodds.com vitest run app/utils/__tests__/semantic-search.server.test.ts
          npm run typecheck --workspace kentcdodds.com
          npm run lint --workspace kentcdodds.com

  deploy:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --workspace=kentcdodds.com

      - name: Build Worker
        run: npm run build --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: Upload Worker Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: lexical-search-worker-build
          path: services/lexical-search-worker/dist

      - name: Deploy Worker
        run: |
          # Add deployment commands here
          echo "Deploying Worker..."
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up two jobs: `build-and-test` and `deploy`. The `build-and-test` job checks out the code, sets up Node.js, installs dependencies, and runs tests for both the `lexical-search-worker` and the main project (`kentcdodds.com`). The `deploy` job waits for the `build-and-test` job to succeed, then builds the Worker, uploads the build artifact, and deploys the Worker. You will need to add the actual deployment commands in the `Deploy Worker` step.
